children: British chip components maker IQE Plc
posted a half-yearly core profit on Monday, compared to a year-ago loss, helped by strong demand from AI infrastructure and data centre and defence customers.
The company reported adjusted core profit of £6 million ($8.11 million) for the six months ended June 30, compared with a loss of £0.4 million in the prior-year period.
